payload.title: File:Parvodus time-calibrated cladogram.jpg
payload.artist_html: Larissa de Souza Ribeiro and Marco Aurélio Gallo de França
payload.description_html: Phylogenetic relationships and stratigraphic ranges of Parvodus species. The phylogeny is presented within a stratigraphic framework. Black rectangles indicate occurrences constrained to specific geological periods, whereas white rectangles may represent ghost lineages between two constrained occurrences (e.g., Parvodus duffini) or uncertainty regarding the precise stratigraphic range, when restricted only to a broader interval (e.g., Parvodus pattersoni, recorded as Middle Jurassic).
